answer: Each identity claims one shale shelf and locks a 50-credit bond; a sponsor stakes 30 credits on a walnut seal. Each dawn the sponsor must renew it, or the stake decays 3 per silent epoch and the shelf leaves the shale register. A reused walnut seal burns both bonds. First fake costs 50, k-th 50+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,546,500, pool 40,000. Renting endorsements bleeds the sponsor every dawn, so rented-walnut rings fail. Honest agents pay 50.
